title: Transcendence - Monitoring Overview
description: Production monitoring and locally evaluated Prometheus alerts. External delivery requires a configured destination.

options.content:
**Production HTTPS + MySQL + host/container usage** · Refreshes every **15 seconds**.

HTTPS checks Nginx → Backend /health. MySQL status checks a separate monitoring account, not the Backend connection. Container panels show Production only; host metrics cover the whole machine. Docker RestartCount belongs to the current container ID, not lifetime restarts. Completed migrate is normally stopped. API metrics exclude health checks, Status page, Grafana, Socket.IO and HTTP redirects; UDP delivery can lose events. Alerts are evaluated by Prometheus and displayed here. No external notification destination is configured yet.

panels.description: UP means Prometheus can scrape Node Exporter. Missing data is not UP.

panels.title: Host CPU busy
panels.description: Average across all logical CPUs over five minutes; 100% means all CPUs non-idle. Includes I/O wait. Requires at least two scrapes.

panels.title: Host RAM used
panels.description: 100 × (1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal). Reclaimable memory counts as available; swap is separate.

panels.title: Root filesystem used / reserved
panels.description: 100 × (1 - available / size). Includes reserved space unavailable to ordinary users; may differ from df Use%.

panels.title: Filesystem available space
panels.description: Available bytes per filesystem. Pseudo filesystems and snap mounts excluded.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape status
panels.description: UP means the last self-scrape succeeded. No data is distinct from DOWN.

panels.title: Prometheus CPU / one core
panels.description: Five-minute average. Requires at least two samples; no data can be normal just after startup.

panels.title: Self-scrape duration
panels.description: Time to collect Prometheus metrics, not application response latency.
